name: Weak Legacy
seoDescription: Weak Legacy codes grant Spins, resets, Yen, and rare items to customize your Demon Slayer-inspired fighter in Roblox’s intense RPG world.
introMd: Weak Legacy is a Roblox RPG inspired by Demon Slayer where you start weak and grow stronger by fighting or choosing to be a demon. Codes in the game give you free Spins, Resets, Yen, and other useful items that help you build your character faster. Using Weak Legacy codes can save you time and let you experiment with different skills or breathing styles without grinding too much.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Weak Legacy Codes
You don’t need any special level or item to redeem codes. Just follow these steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Weak Legacy]] on Roblox.
2. Press M on your keyboard or tap the Menu button on mobile.
3. Find the text box labeled Enter Your Code.
4. Copy and paste a working code into the box.
5. Press Enter or tap Return to claim your rewards.
Make sure to enter codes exactly as shown to avoid errors.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Weak Legacy mostly grant items that directly impact your fighting ability and progression. Here’s what you can expect:

| Reward Type         | Description                                                                                 |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Spins              | Used to spin for Clans or skills, essential for building your character’s fighting style.  |
| Fate Spins         | Special spins that often yield rare or powerful rewards.                                   |
| Crystal Essence    | A resource used for upgrades or crafting within the game.                                  |
| Yen                | The in-game currency to buy weapons, items, or upgrades.                                  |
| Reset Breathing    | Allows you to reset your breathing style to try a new one or optimize your build.          |
| Reset Race        | Lets you reset your race choice, which can affect your stats and abilities.                 |
| Rerolls           | Used to reroll certain abilities or stats, giving you a chance at better outcomes.          |
| Potions           | Consumables that provide buffs or restore resources during battles.                         |
| Mystery Ores      | Special crafting materials used for upgrading gear or unlocking features.                   |

These rewards are tailored to help you customize your character and try different builds without heavy grinding.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes in Weak Legacy often fail because they expire quickly or are typed incorrectly. The game’s codes can be long and tricky, so copying and pasting is best. If a code doesn’t show a redemption message, it’s likely expired or entered wrong.
findCodesMd:
## Where to Find New Weak Legacy Codes
Weak Legacy codes are mainly released by the developer HealQX through the official Weak Legacy Discord server. The developer’s YouTube channel also shares updates and new codes occasionally. Codes drop during game updates, events, or milestones. For the latest codes, check the #codes channel in the Discord and the developer’s socials listed below.
